Author: mithro_

Author: glaxus_
Content:
I’ve also taken a look at xls - it’s neat just to be able to generate some blocks using it.

I think for our purposes, it seems like there’s 2 things we’d need to integrate end to end with our flow IIUC: having chip_core.sv available as a template usable when we write xls code to be able to wire to the pads, as well as setting up the XLS FDO path with the GF PDK so xls gets useful timing estimates.

I wonder if there’s anyone with more experience that might be able to comment.
